About

Design Thinking in Action

This portfolio demonstrates a systematic, research-first approach to brand design. Rather than jumping to aesthetics, each project starts with deep industry research, customer insight, competitive analysis, and strategic thinking.

Every design decision is documented. Every prompt is verbatim. The process is transparent because the work isn't about making pretty things — it's about making things that work.

Using Claude as the creative execution engine, this portfolio shows how AI and human creativity can collaborate at scale: humans direct the vision, AI executes the work.
